rv.q: The excess of swearing alone means this won't be for everyone, but you cannot deny the amount of work and energy expended in bringing WHY I STUCK A FLARE UP MY ARSE FOR ENGLAND to the stage.
Hill's heavily physical and emotional performances gives Why I Stuck A Flare … interest beyond its title.

cn.t: Hill's audacious solo play wins over critics with its lively, sports-themed storytelling and bold humor, proving worth the journey to see this viral incident transformed into engaging West End entertainment.
